_comment: Knobs for the CI job layout; what each one means is in the docstring of tests/oot_framework/utils/test_layout.py. Timings come from .github/test_timings.json (p50_min: per-run sum of case durations, not job wall time), regenerated by tests/scripts/refresh_test_timings.py. exclude keeps a config alone on its runner, including one whose tests cannot be split across cards. Delete this file to run every config as its own job on its runner_overrides.yaml runner.
